description.ja: 漫画『ULTRAMAN』より「ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5」がFigure-rise Standardに登場！
description.en: "ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5 " from the manga " ULTRAMAN" is now available in Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: • 本体表面の銀色はエクストラフィニッシュ、赤色はグロスインジェクションで質感を再現。
description.en: • The silver color on the main body surface is extra finish, and the red color is gloss injection to reproduce the texture.

description.ja: • 専用のLEDユニットが付属し、目を光らせることが可能。
description.en: • A dedicated LED unit is included, allowing you to keep an eye on it.

description.ja: • 「ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5」の主要武装のほか、原作者・清水栄一氏デザインの「EYE SLUGGER」がオリジナル武器パーツとして付属。
description.en: • In addition to the main weapons of "ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5 ", " EYE SLUGGER" designed by the original author Eiichi Shimizu is included as an original weapon part.

description.ja: • 「EYE SLUGGER」は両手に携行することが可能。
description.en: • "EYE SLUGGER" can be carried in both hands.

description.ja: • ２つの「EYE SLUGGER」を合体させることができるジョイントパーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with joint parts that can combine two "EYE SLUGGER".
